product_metadata.title: Modway Emily Tufted Button Faux Leather Upholstered Queen Headboard in White
features: TUFTED HEADBOARD - Classically elegant, this queen headboard features a tufted design that adds chic sophistication to any bedroom, creating an ideal backdrop for bedding and shams of many styles.
PADDED HEADBOARD - Made with durable fiberboard and plywood, this sturdy upholstered headboard is padded with dense foam for comfortable, supportive relaxation
VEGAN LEATHER HEADBOARD - Quality Vegan Leather fabric covers this upholstered headboard. Boasting a tranquil hue, this headboard for queen beds incorporates a sense of calm and relaxation
STATEMENT PIECE - The perfect update for a master bedroom or guest room, this headboard for queen beds makes an elegant statement wherever it rests
ADJUSTABLE HEIGHT HEADBOARD - This upholstered Vegan Leather headboard has seven height adjustable mounting positions for a customizable look that attaches to most queen bed frames
description: Add elegance to your bedroom with the Modway Emily Button Tufted Vegan Leather Upholstered Queen Headboard. Designed with just the right amount of grace, Emily Queen Headboard is made from fiberboard, plywood, and luxurious Vegan Leather upholstery for a construction that is both lightweight and long-lasting. Perfect for contemporary and modern bedrooms, sleep soundly and impart a sense of tranquility amidst an impressive backdrop of style with this headboard for queen beds.

details.Warranty Description: One year warranty against manufacturer defects.
